project: Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture for elliptic curves over Q
goal_general: For every elliptic curve over Q prove equality of Mordell–Weil rank and complex L-function order of vanishing, and the full normalized leading coefficient formula with Sha finiteness.
goal_specific: For E=234446.a1, known algebraic rank four, establish exact complex L''(E,1)=0 and nonzero fourth derivative to prove exact analytic rank four; subsequently address Sha finiteness and BSD leading coefficient.
mathematical_breakthrough_since_previous: NONE toward general BSD, original complex L''(E,1)=0 or Sha finiteness. C-0012 exactly derives canonical sigma c11=4 mod11 using Mazur–Stein–Tate formal-series/integrality and reproduces published E37/p5 polynomial. Conditional on BCLMN global height normalization, computes all four self-heights (100,90,7,8) mod121 and six mixed heights satisfying polarization, with direct 36-point denominator primitivity tests. Independent Sage/Magma global height certification, derived regulator, complex L'' comparison are missing.
